themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are experiencing intense polling dynamics and coalition friction as major election dates approach. In Spain, Vox and the PP maintain strong combined polling leads ahead of the November 29 snap election, while France's Rassemblement National leads 2027 presidential polls, Germany's AfD clashes with mainstream candidates, and Hungary's opposition Tisza party posts record gains against Fidesz.
